newsitem.title: USA: Conrail, Illinois Central set intermodal link.
newsitem.headline: Conrail, Illinois Central set intermodal link.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it and Illinois Central Corp will offer SouthRunner intermodal service beginning February 26.

The direct intermodal service linking Memphis and other Midsouth points with major U.S. markets in the Northeast and Midwest will offer shippers transit times up to one full day faster than existing intermodal competition between many of these points, the railroad said.

Operating northbound and southbound seven days a week, SouthRunner will provide shippers with service between Memphis, Tenn.; Jackson, Miss.; Mobile, Ala.; and New Orleans and all major markets on the Conrail Intermodal network, including Boston, Worcester and Springfield, Mass.; Waterville, Maine; the North Jersey/New York City region; Philadelphia, Morrisville, Allentown and Harrisburg, Pa.; and Columbus, Ohio.
